'''2000 Ord Mantell Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Ord Mantell region (Japan) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00ordmantell">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ordmantell 2000 Regionals: Ord Mantell], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140113/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ordmantell Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Kouji Yukuhisa]] of Wakabayashi, Japan won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 6 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Future Bee Suidobashi Shop 2F, Sanpou Suidobashi Building, 1-4-11, Nishikanda, Chiyoda-Ku, Tokyo, Tokyo Japan
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Shin Okada]]
